We want everyone who dines with us to do so happily and safely, so we take dietary restrictions and allergies very seriously.
Our chefs will personally mark up menus to indicate which dishes are appropriate for dietary restrictions or allergies.
If you are unsure if you will be able to dine with us due to dietary restrictions, please email us and we'll do our best to communicate potential accommodations in advance.
